newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Hindustan copper cancels cathodes import.
newsitem.headline: India's Hindustan copper cancels cathodes import.

text.p: India's state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd (HCL) said on Wednesday it had cancelled a tender for the import of 30,000 tonnes of "A" grade copper cathodes.
"Due to unavoidable circumstances the tender for import of 30,000 tonees cathodes has been cancelled," R.P. Singh, HCL's assistant general manager (commercial), told Reuters by telephone.
Singh gave no reason for the cancellation.
The tender document issued a week ago had said offers should reach HCL's headquarters in Calcutta by 2.30 p.m (0900 GMT) on November 3 and would be opened on the same day.
"Due to unavoidable circumstances we have decided to cancel this tender," a company statement received later said.
HCL is India's largest copper producer.
